definitions.full: H3361. Yoqmeam יָקְמְעָם proper name, of a location (perhaps = יְקָמְעָם i.e. עָם יָ֫קָם Ol § 277k, 3 ; = let the people be established ? compare Gray Prop. N. 218 ); — in Northern Israel 1Kin 4:12 , Λουκαμ, ᵐ5 L Ουκαμ ; possibly = modern Tel Kaimûn , north of Megiddo, Buhl Geogr. 210 ; city of refuge in Ephraim 1Chr 6:53 ( = קִבְצַיִם [q. v.] Josh 21:22 ), Ικααμ , Ιεκμααν , etc. קוֺנֵן see קין .
definitions.rootNote: from 6965 and 5971 ; (the) people will be raised ;

occurrences.englishText: Baana the son of Ahilud, in Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth Shean which is beside Zarethan, beneath Jezreel, from Beth Shean to Abel Meholah, as far as beyond Jokmeam;
